purpose: One segment of a Breadcrumb trail: a link to an ancestor page, or the current page as plain text. Not for standalone use.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a Breadcrumb.
A standalone inline link in text.
A navigation row in a side rail.

Default.visual: default: label Content/secondary. ghost has no fill; outline adds a Border/control stroke; solid fills Surface/muted.

Hover.visual: default: label Content/accent (outline stroke Border/accent, solid fill Surface/accent). secondary: label Content/primary (outline stroke Border/control-hover, solid fill Surface/muted-hover).

Focused.visual: default: Border/focus stroke with a Border/ring/default halo. secondary: Border/strong stroke with a Border/subtle halo. Label stays Content/secondary.

Current.meaning: The page the person is on (aria-current="page"), not interactive.
Current.visual: Label Content/primary; outline stroke Border/default, solid fill Surface/muted.

Disabled.visual: Label Content/disabled; outline stroke Border/subtle, solid fill Action/disabled/default.

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it unless it is current or disabled; Enter follows the link.
notes: The current item is aria-current="page" and not interactive.
Use asChild for the router link.

openQuestions: Motion: the State axis has no motion decision and recipes/motion.ts has no entry (finding MOT-002). Should hover and focus colour changes animate (for example use-hover)?
Disabled: when is an ancestor segment disabled rather than simply left out, and should it leave the Tab order?
